01_no_anticipation.doc: Before the first epoch every world's plan equals the here-and-now plan; after it, worlds of one set share the plan (structural check on solved values).

02_same_information_same_decision.doc: Two worlds with identical observable histories map to the same information set at every epoch (N3, W2).

03_set_probabilities_sum.doc: Information-set probabilities equal the sums of member weights and sum to one per epoch.

04_world_probabilities_preserved.doc: The tree worlds' weights sum to one and every branch keeps its history weight split evenly over its continuations.

05_static_feasible.doc: The static comparator is a feasible static plan under the frozen rows (usable) wherever a static plan exists.

06_adaptive_feasible_every_world.doc: Every represented world settles under its own policy plan (no physical violation, no guidance truncation).

07_committed_stays_committed.doc: Purchases before the first epoch are identical in every world's plan and equal the here-and-now plan (no cancellation, no retroactive change).

08_no_negative_inventory.doc: Settlement of every world plan reports no negative stock (settlement raises on any physical violation).

09_network_conservation.doc: On the P2 recourse fixture the settled conservation residual is zero in every world.

10_no_double_allocation.doc: Period-0 transfers of the adaptive plan never exceed opening stock at the origin (settlement strict at period zero, every world).

11_source_capacity.doc: No branch buys above a source's capacity or maximum (I3, I6).

12_shared_supplier_capacity.doc: Shared resources hold in every branch (I6).

14_mov.doc: Every branch's supplier order meets the MOV or is absent (shared supplier orders counted once per node).

17_transfer_lead_time.doc: A recourse transfer decided at epoch e cannot arrive before e + lane lead (columns exist only for t >= e; arrival = t + lead).
17_transfer_lead_time.evidence: every recourse transfer departs at or after its epoch

18_sector_physics.doc: Sector fixtures settle in every world (physics enforced by the same rows and settlement).

19_shelf_life_fefo.doc: Produce fixture: no world plan settles with expired sales (settlement's FEFO and life rules).

20_cold_chain.doc: Meat / seafood fixture: every world plan settles under the cold-chain and receipt-life rules.

23_perfect_le_adaptive.doc:
PI <= adaptive on every fixture whose perfect-information solve is CERTIFIED (status OPTIMAL); a
feasible time-limited PI incumbent is not a bound and is listed, not compared (release audit blocker A).
23_perfect_le_adaptive.evidence: PI <= adaptive on 25 certified PI solves; non-certified (not compared): ['S1_commercial_packs']

24_adaptive_le_static.evidence: adaptive <= static wherever a static plan exists

25_disabled_is_frozen.evidence: reports identical up to timings and the request hash

26_signature_order_independent.doc: Reversing the world order changes no information-set membership signature and no probability.
26_signature_order_independent.evidence: signatures, probabilities and memberships invariant under world reordering

27_signature_uses_no_future.doc: Changing any world's demand at or after the epoch never changes its signature at that epoch.
27_signature_uses_no_future.evidence: epoch 3: future demand doubled, signature unchanged
